oag.reference: {code} is {name}, according to OAG Master Data.
oag.connections: OAG lists {flights} for {origin} to {destination} on {date}. These are scheduled itineraries. Confirm availability and transfer arrangements with the airline.
oag.flight: OAG lists {flight} from {origin} to {destination} on {date}. Scheduled departure at origin is {time}. Reported status is {status}.
oag.ask_route: Enter the departure and arrival airport codes, for example Connections from DXB to LHR tomorrow.
oag.ask_flight: Enter an airline and flight number, for example Flight status EK202.
oag.ask_flight_route: OAG found more than one flight instance. Include the departure and arrival airports to narrow it down.
oag.ask_date: Enter a valid departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
oag.no_results: OAG returned no matching results for those details. Check the codes and date.
oag.invalid: Check the flight number, airport codes and departure date.
oag.offline: OAG lookups are offline. Use the airport displays or ask your airline for current flight information.
oag.unavailable: OAG data is unavailable right now. Use the airport displays or ask your airline.
oag.busy: OAG is limiting lookups right now. Try again later or ask your airline.
oag.transfer_signs: Follow the Connections signs. Check the Dubai departure screens for your onward flight.
oag.transfer_flight: Enter the onward flight number from your boarding pass and I’ll check its gate.
oag.reported_gate: OAG reported departure gate {gate} at {time}. Check the airport displays for the latest gate.
